# Project Guidance

## Product intent

This project is intended to become an AI-assisted virtual wig try-on experience. Users should be able to explore wig styles and preview how they fit across different facial appearances and head sizes.

## Current repository state

The repository currently contains only the project README. No framework, runtime, dependency manager, build command, test runner, or deployment target has been selected yet.

## Implementation expectations

- Confirm the application stack before adding framework-specific structure or dependencies.
- Keep face and head-size handling explicit, testable, and privacy-conscious.
- Prefer accessible, responsive UI for the try-on workflow.
- Document setup, development, testing, and model requirements as they are introduced.
- Keep changes focused and avoid adding generated or vendor files to the repository.
